steps.label: Thermal fluctuations
steps.sub: Even near 10-20 mK, small temperature changes shift behavior measurably

steps.label: Material defects (TLS)
steps.sub: Microscopic two-level defects in dielectrics couple to and perturb the qubit

steps.label: Flux noise
steps.sub: Low-frequency magnetic noise wanders a flux-tunable qubit's frequency over time

steps.label: Re-measure parameters
steps.sub: Frequency, pulse amplitudes/timings, readout discrimination — all re-checked

steps.label: A real operational cost
steps.sub: Time spent recalibrating is time the device isn't running user circuits

steps.label: Cadence varies
steps.sub: Set per provider and platform — no single universal schedule
